newsitem.title: THAILAND: Value of Thai vehicles, parts exports falls.
newsitem.headline: Value of Thai vehicles, parts exports falls.

text.p: The value of Thai exports of assembled vehicles and parts from January to July fell 16.76 percent to 5.2 billion baht from 6.24 billion baht in the same period last year, an industry group said on Friday.

The value of assembled cars and parts during the January to July period was down 27 percent to 1.44 billion baht from 1.97 billion baht in the same period last year, the Thai Automobile Industry Association said.
The value of motorcycles and motorcycle part exports in the first seven months fell 12 percent to 3.76 billion baht from 4.27 billion baht the year before, the association said.

The total number of passenger cars and commercial vehicles assembled in Thailand in the first seven months was up 8.25 percent to 314,591 units against 290,616 units in the same period a year ago. ($1 = 25 baht)
